quotes.name: Strength of the Coalition
quotes.flavor:
"Root and wing, claw and sword; this will be a memorable stand, indeed."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

quotes.name: Omnispell Adept
quotes.flavor: She memorized every arcane text in the Ismeri Library by the time she was sixteen. Now she quizzes sphinxes in her spare time.

quotes.name: Blex, Vexing Pest // Search for Blex
quotes.flavor: Pests are typically harvested before they outgrow their enclosures. Blex is far from typical.

quotes.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
quotes.flavor: A true follower of Tourach took pride in achievement to the exclusion of other concerns.

quotes.name: Fluctuator
quotes.flavor:
"It generates power by harnessing the nature of possibility itself."
"But will it work?"
". . . Possibly."

quotes.name: Tavern Scoundrel
quotes.flavor: "No refunds. I cheated you fair and square."

quotes.name: Havengul Vampire
quotes.flavor: "That slowly decreasing pulse—that's the beat I waltz to."

quotes.name: Dreamstone Hedron
quotes.flavor: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: Mercy is for those who keep their distance.

quotes.name: Goblin Fireslinger
quotes.flavor: A rock between your eyes hurts. A burning rock between your eyes ruins your whole day.

quotes.name: Bite Down
quotes.flavor:
"All the fancy spells and diabolical machines in the Multiverse are nothing compared to a good chomp."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Abyssal Horror
quotes.flavor:
"I dreamt of it once. Now I fear it dreams of me."
—Tolarian scholar

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: It came from beyond Valley. Not a calamity like the Great Maha, and not animalfolk. It was something new.

quotes.name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
quotes.flavor: His heart had become as hard and sharp as the diamonds he wielded.

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

quotes.name: Unburden
quotes.flavor:
"Ambition requires clarity. If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned."
—Bontu, god of ambition

quotes.name: Blightspeaker
quotes.flavor: One croaked sermon spreads propaganda and plague.

quotes.name: Vile Entomber
quotes.flavor: The dead are lonely in the crypt and always eager for company.

quotes.name: Kai Winn, Faithless Leader
quotes.flavor: It took masterful insight to lie with the Prophets' own words.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.flavor:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Darksteel Ingot
quotes.flavor:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Plague Wight
quotes.flavor: For some goods, the best couriers are the dead.

quotes.name: Saga of Krark Losing His Thumb
quotes.flavor: Designed by players at MagicCon Las Vegas 2025.

quotes.name: Mighty Leap
quotes.flavor:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

quotes.name: Stone Giant
quotes.flavor: What goes up, must come down.

quotes.name: Wild Elephant
quotes.flavor:
"I will tell my father's stories . . . . How the elephants trampled the leopard cub, and its father, though he knew, killed nine goats instead."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

quotes.name: Vulturous Zombie
quotes.flavor:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Eye of Ugin
quotes.flavor: Droplets of an idea pool, until the dam breaks and the flood is unleashed.

quotes.name: Determined Iteration
quotes.flavor: "Only a fool believes they have nothing left to learn."

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: "Power. Such an ephemeral commodity—hard to gain, easy to lose. And I once thought I understood it. What vanity."

quotes.name: Verdant Force
quotes.flavor:
Burl, scurf, and bower
Birth fern and flower.

quotes.name: Mirari
quotes.flavor:
"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Spider-Rex, Daring Dino
quotes.flavor: On Earth-66, Pter Ptarker learned that with GRRRR power comes GRRAHHHsibility.

quotes.name: Branching Evolution
quotes.flavor:
"Is it the water? The stars? Whatever it is, something incredible is happening here."
—Eris, zoologist, journal entry

quotes.name: Shivan Gorge
quotes.flavor: Both forge and pyre.

quotes.name: Vindictive Lich
quotes.flavor: Heart, mind, soul—weapons all.

quotes.name: Deathcap Cultivator
quotes.flavor: The old hermit would never say what he fed his mushrooms, and people learned not to ask.

quotes.name: Cutthroat il-Dal
quotes.flavor: Her blades slashed across the noble's shadow. He scoffed, then fell over dead.

quotes.name: Hazoret's Monument
quotes.flavor:
"The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Ambassador Oak
quotes.flavor: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

quotes.name: Kiss of Death
quotes.flavor:
"I'd sooner lock lips with a viper. At least I might walk away from *that*."
—Elvish scout

quotes.name: Gravewaker
quotes.flavor: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

quotes.name: Wayward Giant
quotes.flavor:
"The giants follow the flow of aether, and twice a year it leads them through here. Lesson learned. More clearance is needed."
—Sram, senior edificer

quotes.name: Decimate
quotes.flavor:
"Anyone can admire creation. Only a barbarian sees the beauty in demolition."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Spirit en-Kor
quotes.flavor:
Death free throat from thirst, mouth from speech, feet from earth.
—Kor requiem

quotes.name: Meticulous Commons
quotes.flavor:
"We present a new way to calculate predictions based upon the *absence* of data."
—Fatehold and Theorix joint project

quotes.name: Desperate Ravings
quotes.flavor: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

quotes.name: Foot Soldiers
quotes.flavor: Infantry deployment is the art of putting your troops in the wrong place at the right time.

quotes.name: Talisman of Curiosity
quotes.flavor:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

quotes.name: Magnificent End
quotes.flavor: The flames were near him. His companions were leaving him. He bent his bow for the last time.

quotes.name: Finale of Revelation
quotes.flavor: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Blowfly Infestation
quotes.flavor: Blowflies only infest corpses, but if none are available, they have no trouble making some.

quotes.name: Hellkite Igniter
quotes.flavor: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

quotes.name: Archivist of Oghma
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is the greatest tool of the mortal mind, outweighing anything made by mortal hands. Before anything else can exist, the idea must exist."

quotes.name: Tibalt's Rager
quotes.flavor:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

quotes.name: Sage of the Unknowable
quotes.flavor: "Someday, we will walk the Blind Eternities and see the truths that lie beyond the stifling veil of reality."

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Flamekin Brawler
quotes.flavor: When he hits people, they stay hit.

quotes.name: Combustion Man
quotes.flavor:
"The Avatar's alive. I want you to find him, and end him."
—Zuko

quotes.name: Watercourser
quotes.flavor:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

quotes.name: Vintara Snapper
quotes.flavor:
"The snapper is still when all else moves
And strikes when all are dozing."
—*Tales of the Vintara Forest*

quotes.name: Spinneret Sliver
quotes.flavor: Each new generation of slivers evolves to assimilate the strengths of the prey upon which their progenitors fed.

quotes.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
quotes.flavor: "My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Though I must admit I could get used to this."

quotes.name: Priest of Titania
quotes.flavor: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

quotes.name: Culling the Weak
quotes.flavor:
"The blood of the weak shall be the ink with which we scribe great Yawgmoth's glorious name."
—Stronghold architect, journal

quotes.name: Deathgazer
quotes.flavor: Your entire life passes before its eyes.

quotes.name: Elvish Archdruid
quotes.flavor: "The elves tend the forest, and the forest sustains the elves. My role is to ensure that the cycle continues."

quotes.name: Pilgrim's Eye
quotes.flavor: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

quotes.name: Threads of Disloyalty
quotes.flavor:
"Over time, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Sizzling Changeling
quotes.flavor: Burrenton's forges call to it, and it arrives whenever they need to be relit.

quotes.name: Mardu Heart-Piercer
quotes.flavor: "Those who have never ridden before the wind do not know the true joy of war."

quotes.name: Dictate of Kruphix
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is cruel. It will break your heart and test your allegiances. Are you certain you want this curse?"

quotes.name: Crackling Triton
quotes.flavor: He calls upon both the currents in the sea and the current in the clouds.

quotes.name: Temporal Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All her classmates have disappeared."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

quotes.name: Heckling Fiends
quotes.flavor: Their language may be a cacophonous agglomeration of chittering snorts and mad barking, but the message they send is all too clear.

quotes.name: Astral Slide
quotes.flavor:
"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Drana's Emissary
quotes.flavor: "The taste of freedom is sweeter than blood."

quotes.name: Boompile
quotes.flavor:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now . . . which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

quotes.name: Yawgmoth's Vile Offering
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, a mad god offered a simple trade.

quotes.name: Nef-Crop Entangler
quotes.flavor: "If you do not feel the thrill of battle, alive like a flame, you will never triumph."

quotes.name: Marshdrinker Giant
quotes.flavor: When giants rise from their long slumbers, they rarely remember how fragile the waking world can be.

quotes.name: Aegis of the Heavens
quotes.flavor: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.

quotes.name: Copperline Gorge
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: Where fire meets ferocity, a greater evolution begins.

quotes.name: Ashnod's Altar
quotes.flavor:
"So, logically . . . "
"If she weighs the same as a duck, she's made of wood . . . "
"And therefore . . . "
"A witch!"

quotes.name: Battlefield Forge
quotes.flavor:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Cloudspire Skycycle
quotes.flavor: For Team Cloudspire, the track is merely a suggestion.

quotes.name: Tyrant's Scorn
quotes.flavor: Barroom Fracas Disrupts Hootenanny- Instigator Removed

quotes.name: Sylvan Basilisk
quotes.flavor:
"We're not sure what one looks like, so to be safe, nobody look at anything until we're out of here."
—Parbold Drix, veteran explorer

quotes.name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
quotes.flavor: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

quotes.name: Academy Loremaster
quotes.flavor: As a young student, she dusted the shelves of Tolaria's great library. Now, she writes the books that line them.

quotes.name: Flames of the Raze-Boar
quotes.flavor: "Fire will cure a multitude of ills."

quotes.name: Stone Rain
quotes.flavor:
"The land shall beg for drink and curse the rain that follows."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor: The remains of ancient civilizations litter the run-down land.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Peppersmoke
quotes.flavor: Like being trapped in a perpetual sneeze, faerie-dust poisoning is both exhilarating and agonizing.

quotes.name: Rancor
quotes.flavor: Hatred outlives the hateful.

quotes.name: Scour from Existence
quotes.flavor:
"Our people and our very lands disappear as if they never were. We no longer fight for glory, or honor. We battle now for the right to exist."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Jandor's Saddlebags
quotes.flavor: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

quotes.name: Warship Scout
quotes.flavor: "For the glory of the Fire Nation!"

quotes.name: Fen Hauler
quotes.flavor:
"Success is found where others fear to look."
—Ara, renegade smuggler

quotes.name: Overflowing Insight
quotes.flavor: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

quotes.name: Mask of Griselbrand
quotes.flavor: The legacy of evil lives on.

quotes.name: Champion Lancer
quotes.flavor: The flash of his lance projects the pure radiance of his honor.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Yavimaya Coast
quotes.flavor: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

quotes.name: Doran, the Siege Tower
quotes.flavor: "Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."

quotes.name: Orzhov Signet
quotes.flavor: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

quotes.name: Duskborne Skymarcher
quotes.flavor: "The hour of Dusk is come."

quotes.name: Mishra's Bauble
quotes.flavor:
"The secrets of my great-uncle's heirloom lie in the world where it was forged: the grease-stained wastes of Phyrexia."
—Jarsyl, diary

quotes.name: Cruel Edict
quotes.flavor:
"Choose your next words carefully. They will be your last."
—Phage the Untouchable

quotes.name: Impulse
quotes.flavor:
"I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: "You can't learn to enjoy life's amusements in the pages of books. You must seek them out in earnest."

quotes.name: Deserter's Quarters
quotes.flavor: In Akros, the penalty for running from battle is one night's stay in the Deserter's Quarters.

quotes.name: Hadana's Climb // Winged Temple of Orazca
quotes.flavor: Hadana seeks power in the service of peace.

quotes.name: Vedalken Certarch
quotes.flavor: "An appropriately detailed model is indistinguishable from reality, and much easier to control."

quotes.name: Gifted Aetherborn
quotes.flavor: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

quotes.name: Perish the Thought
quotes.flavor: It removed only one idea from her mind: defiance.

quotes.name: Lightning Elemental
quotes.flavor: A lightning elemental once killed an entire tribe of merfolk—simply by going for a swim.

quotes.name: Disdainful Stroke
quotes.flavor: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

quotes.name: Flowstone Charger
quotes.flavor: A mane of flowstone and a mien of fury.

quotes.name: High Stride
quotes.flavor:
"It takes a moment to find your stride, but once you do, you'll feel like a giant!"
—Brisco, river guide

quotes.name: Zendikar Incarnate
quotes.flavor:
"Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath. That is why Nissa is the last of the animists."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

quotes.name: Silent Sentinel
quotes.flavor: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

quotes.name: Energy Bolt
quotes.flavor: Life and death are two faces of the same coin.

quotes.name: Inexorable Tide
quotes.flavor: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

quotes.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
quotes.flavor: "About, about in reel and rout The death-fires danced at night; The water, like a witch's oils, Burnt green, and blue and white." —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Deny the Witch
quotes.flavor: "This heresy cannot stand!"

quotes.name: Gallows Warden
quotes.flavor: The spirit cares nothing for the crimes or triumphs of the slain. It shelters all beneath its stormy cloak.

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Blood Crypt // Blood Crypt
quotes.flavor:
"Remember, my little foragers, only bring me back finger bones. No toes!"
—Auntie Grub

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

quotes.name: Summary Judgment
quotes.flavor: Any challenge to Azorius authority is met with swift and potent retribution.

quotes.name: Sulfur Falls
quotes.flavor: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.

quotes.name: Eccentric Farmer
quotes.flavor: "Careful now. Don't want to get the seeds stuck to your feelers like last time."

quotes.name: Henrika Domnathi // Henrika, Infernal Seer
quotes.flavor: "Once you've tasted demon blood, you'll wonder why you ever settled for human."

quotes.name: Chupacabra Echo
quotes.flavor: It needs no food, yet still it hungers.

quotes.name: Songstitcher
quotes.flavor: The true names of birds are songs woven into their souls.

quotes.name: Monitor Monitor
quotes.flavor: Nine fires, a hull breach, and a Quafloovian meganibbler escaped from the petting zoo. Things were suspiciously quiet.

quotes.name: Rally the Peasants
quotes.flavor:
"If you must go out at night, bring a mob."
—Master of the Elgaud Cathars

quotes.name: Open the Vaults
quotes.flavor:
"It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."
—Overseer

quotes.name: The Fish Brewer
quotes.flavor: FROM

quotes.name: Arming Gala
quotes.flavor: For the Cabaretti, everything is a party.

quotes.name: Faerie Invaders
quotes.flavor: Small enough to penetrate the narrowest crack in a castle wall and numerous enough to hack apart a griffin.

quotes.name: Ori, Keeper of Songs
quotes.flavor: The music began all at once, so sudden and sweet that Bilbo forgot everything else.

quotes.name: Captain of the Mists
quotes.flavor: "I am no mere ship's captain. The north wind is my accomplice. The tide is my first mate."

quotes.name: Veinwitch Coven
quotes.flavor: Some Strixhaven study groups are more welcoming than others.

quotes.name: Knollspine Dragon
quotes.flavor: It woke to find a vast world in need of a master.

quotes.name: Broodmate Dragon
quotes.flavor: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter—and were promptly eaten by its diving mate.

quotes.name: Inspirit
quotes.flavor:
"The hour of your redemption is here. . . . Rally to me. . . . rise and strike. Strike at every favorable opportunity. For your homes and hearths, strike!"
—General Douglas MacArthur, to the people of the Philippines

quotes.name: Snakeskin Veil
quotes.flavor: Most travelers panic when they stumble upon the skin of a giant rattlewurm. Landry saw it as a gift.

quotes.name: Arwen Undómiel
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: She was called Undómiel, for she was the Evenstar of her people.

quotes.name: Butcher of Malakir
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

quotes.name: Reverberate
quotes.flavor: For every action, there is a swifter and more violent reaction.

quotes.name: Portcullis Vine
quotes.flavor: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."

quotes.name: Dawnfeather Eagle
quotes.flavor:
"It came to rest upon the angel's arm, and then the weight of their gazes fell upon me."
—Aeronaut's journal

quotes.name: Truce
quotes.flavor:
"The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce."
—Eron the Relentless

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

quotes.name: Behind the Scenes
quotes.flavor: It does no good to bar the gate when the enemy is already inside.

quotes.name: Bootleggers' Stash
quotes.flavor: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.

quotes.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: "You are not alone. You never were."

quotes.name: Blood Sun
quotes.flavor: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.

quotes.name: Tactical Officer
quotes.flavor: "Kouassi to bridge. Captain, the intruders look like Starfleet, but their combadge is different. It's . . . a dagger through a planet?"

quotes.name: Sedge Troll
quotes.flavor: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

quotes.name: Dwarven Shortsword
quotes.flavor: Dwarves lived long lives if not felled in battle, and they forged their blades to last even longer.

quotes.name: Puresteel Paladin
quotes.flavor: "I wear the armor. I am the weapon."

quotes.name: Royal Assassin
quotes.flavor: An assassin is a king's most trusted courier, ensuring his messages are heard by even the most unwilling recipients.

quotes.name: Pressure Point
quotes.flavor: Poke a drake in the right place and it becomes as docile as a pet. Poke it in the wrong place and goodbye, hand.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Urza's Incubator
quotes.flavor:
"Stop thinking like an artificer, Urza, and start thinking like a father!"
—Rayne, Academy Chancellor

quotes.name: Glorious Anthem
quotes.flavor: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur Forest

quotes.name: Timetwister
quotes.flavor: 2018 Asia Vintage Champion

quotes.name: Twin Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Fire is only as precise as your control over it."
—Danfeng, Jeskai mage

quotes.name: Constricting Sliver
quotes.flavor: Slivers are often seen toying with enemies they capture, not out of cruelty, but to fully learn their physical capabilities.

quotes.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
quotes.flavor:
"There are intriguing similarities between the Order and Icatia's Leitbur religion, suggesting the two had a common origin."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

quotes.name: Ace, Fearless Rebel
quotes.flavor: "Wicked!"

quotes.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
quotes.flavor: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.

quotes.name: Skystrike Officer
quotes.flavor: "Landing zone is clear. Activate and deploy!"

quotes.name: Hero of Goma Fada
quotes.flavor: "They seek to break us. Let us show them our strength!"

quotes.name: Reconnaissance Mission
quotes.flavor: "We've reached the xenos HQ. Transmitting coordinates now."

quotes.name: Mudbrawler Cohort
quotes.flavor: Before a raid, the members of Wort's gang egg each other on with tales of their hunger and what they'll do to sate it, each outdoing the last.

quotes.name: Zenith Flare
quotes.flavor:
"I defy this world to try our defenses now. Send pterons and skycats. Send Vadrok!"
—Janae, Coppercoat architect

quotes.name: Nessian Hornbeetle
quotes.flavor:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

quotes.name: Winter, Tormented Loner
quotes.flavor: "There is no exit. No end. Not for me."

quotes.name: Nosy Goblin
quotes.flavor: To his surprise, Furt discovered that the strange creatures were not at all like bugs.

quotes.name: Drogskol Captain
quotes.flavor: Dead or alive, true leaders can inspire an entire army.

quotes.name: Haywire Mite
quotes.flavor:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

quotes.name: Bolt Bend
quotes.flavor:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Wanderbrine Rootcutters
quotes.flavor: Most dirtwalkers only know of the vicious merrows that dwell in the shallows. They can't begin to fathom the wickedness that skulks in the Dark Meanders.

quotes.name: Piston Sledge
quotes.flavor: Only the goblins could make a simple machine so complex.

quotes.name: Scared Stiff
quotes.flavor: The horrors of Sorin's Haunted Mansion scared Hurrk half to life.

quotes.name: Star of Extinction
quotes.flavor: "What would happen if there was an injury that threatened the very life of the planet?"

quotes.name: Gran Pulse Ochu
quotes.flavor: A mysterious beast that has grown large on its journey across Gran Pulse. Its children, known as microchus, accompany the ochu in combat against adventurers.

quotes.name: Imperious Perfect
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

quotes.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
quotes.flavor: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Bone Dragon
quotes.flavor: Its roar is the clatter of a thousand bones.

quotes.name: Selfless Police Captain
quotes.flavor:
"Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around. How very odd."
—Captain George Stacy

quotes.name: Grid Monitor
quotes.flavor: The vedalken protect the Knowledge Pool at any cost.

quotes.name: Comparative Analysis
quotes.flavor:
"Our time grows short. If we wish to vanquish the Eldrazi, we must unlock the hedrons' secrets."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

quotes.name: Boggart Brute
quotes.flavor: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

quotes.name: Solitary Defiance
quotes.flavor: Jace constructed a mental vault deep in his consciousness as Phyresis closed in.

quotes.name: Exiled Boggart
quotes.flavor: Among the boggarts, there is only one real rule: all new treasures and experiences must be shared. Those who hoard their gifts commit the one truly unforgivable sin.

quotes.name: Ripjaw Raptor
quotes.flavor: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

quotes.name: Reki, the History of Kamigawa
quotes.flavor:
"After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him. Thus the volume you hold was written."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Air Elemental
quotes.flavor: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

quotes.name: Plot Armor
quotes.flavor: "If you've got words, we're going to have words."

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Wild Pack Squad
quotes.flavor: Silver Sable doesn't accept second best.

quotes.name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
quotes.flavor: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

quotes.name: Warrior's Honor
quotes.flavor:
"We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket."
—Asmira, Rashida, and Jabari, unity chant

quotes.name: Puppeteer
quotes.flavor: "Getting people to do what you want is merely a matter of telling them what they want to hear."

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: Roving Harper
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The Harpers value peaceful coexistence, historical preservation, and harmony with nature, and each day they spread their ideals a little farther.

quotes.name: Lady Zhurong, Warrior Queen
quotes.flavor:
"A man, and such a fool! I, a woman, will fight them for you."
—Lady Zhurong to her husband Meng Huo, before leading an army against the Shu

quotes.name: Wetland Sambar
quotes.flavor: As a test of calm and compassion, a Jeskai monk softly approaches a grazing sambar and offers it a lotus from his or her hand. If the creature eats, the student ascends to the next level of training.

quotes.name: Demystify
quotes.flavor: "The truth will outshine all lies."

quotes.name: Invoke the Ancients
quotes.flavor: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.

quotes.name: Dawntreader Elk
quotes.flavor: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

quotes.name: Approach My Molten Realm
quotes.flavor: "It's a dragon-infested lavascape of notorious peril. Make yourselves at home."

quotes.name: Venomthrope
quotes.flavor:
"See that cloud that hangs around it? More than a minute in there and you'll be bleeding out of places you didn't even know you had."
—Captain Ascote

quotes.name: Moggcatcher
quotes.flavor: "They're not worth much, but they're easy to catch."

quotes.name: Urborg Volcano
quotes.flavor: Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.

quotes.name: Icatian Priest
quotes.flavor:
"May you be strong and valiant, to defeat the enemies of the pure."
—"Leitbur's Prayer"

quotes.name: Soul Manipulation
quotes.flavor:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Disrupting Scepter
quotes.flavor: "True power is controlling not only the hearts of your subjects, but their minds as well."

quotes.name: Thrill of Possibility
quotes.flavor: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."

quotes.name: Elvish Piper
quotes.flavor:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

quotes.name: Steelbane Hydra
quotes.flavor: "Slash was too perfect a weapon for the Null Group to let him rest in peace . . . Even if the knockoffs proved temperamental."

quotes.name: Youthful Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: Helle soared joyfully through the icy dawn. After hearing one thousand tales of her ancestors, she'd finally taken her place among the honored host.

quotes.name: Whirling Dervish
quotes.flavor: Amid this whirling hurricane of blades, there is no calm eye in which the hapless can find shelter.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: "The black lotus rises from adverse conditions and produces a rare bloom. We grow the lotus to remind us to look to the future despite the suffering of the present."

quotes.name: Uneasy Alliance
quotes.flavor: Other perspectives can help one find the proper direction.

quotes.name: Cut the Earthly Bond
quotes.flavor:
"The more kami that passed through the veil that separated them from our world, the weaker that veil became, threatening to tear into tatters at the slightest pressure."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Dakmor Plague
quotes.flavor: The tiniest cough can be deadlier than the fiercest dragon.

quotes.name: Thunderbolt
quotes.flavor:
"Most wizards consider a thunderbolt to be a proper retort."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Nath's Buffoon
quotes.flavor: Smik learned the elvish dance quickly enough. The most difficult, yet most important step was to stay out of Nath's sight until called to perform.

quotes.name: Heir of the Ancient Fang
quotes.flavor: On the last day of a Jukai agent's training, they are bequeathed a powerful relic blessed by the kami.

quotes.name: Fallowsage
quotes.flavor: Memories of ages past are said to swim the minds of lounging fallowsages.

quotes.name: Fury Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

quotes.name: Reg Barclay, Fidgety Fantasist
quotes.flavor: A hero in his own mind.

quotes.name: Glimpse of Nature
quotes.flavor:
「団栗の中に樫の木を見出し、幼獣の中に群れの王を見出すこと。生きとし生けるものの中に、大小や目の前の姿に惑わされず、何になり得るかを見出すこと。」
――「無限の自然」第一巻

quotes.name: Lae'zel, Callous Warrior
quotes.flavor: "You have a sharp tongue, elf. Would that your mind proved its equal."

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

quotes.name: Mox Ruby
quotes.flavor: 2017 European Vintage Champion

quotes.name: Takenuma Bleeder
quotes.flavor: "I prefer to weave my magic through oni blood, but yours will do in a pinch."

quotes.name: Avenge
quotes.flavor:
"Ultron. We would have words with thee."
—Thor

quotes.name: Silverback Ape
quotes.flavor: His true majesty is not in his silver, but in his size.

quotes.name: Doomed Traveler
quotes.flavor: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

quotes.name: Silverflame Squire // On Alert
quotes.flavor: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

quotes.name: Pongify
quotes.flavor: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

quotes.name: Rakdos Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"My servants take pains for your pleasure, and take pleasure in your pain!"
—Rakdos

quotes.name: Reenact the Crime
quotes.flavor:
"As I suspected, Kylox had prepared a secret exit. But the question remains: Did he escape his assailants or was he taken against his will?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

quotes.name: Skirk Shaman
quotes.flavor: In a shaman's grimy hands, a concoction of dried Skirk Ridge herbs can become the face of panic.

quotes.name: Gloomlake Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

quotes.name: Thirst for Meaning
quotes.flavor: A sip of recollection, an ocean of regrets.

quotes.name: Marchesa's Decree
quotes.flavor:
"Those who seize power must have the means to hold it."
—Queen Marchesa

quotes.name: Gatherer of Graces
quotes.flavor: "Garb is for common folk. I prefer to wear insight and zeal, ambition and flame."

quotes.name: Rhino's Rampage
quotes.flavor: Spider-Man wasn't looking to fight, but that was all Rhino wanted.

quotes.name: Tower Geist
quotes.flavor: Jenrik's tower is served by those who once sought to enter it uninvited.

quotes.name: Air Elemental
quotes.flavor: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

quotes.name: Patchwork Gnomes
quotes.flavor: One wizard's trash is another wizard's roving gang of abominations.

quotes.name: Memorial Vault
quotes.flavor: Kavaron cannot be saved, but its culture can.

quotes.name: Goblin Electromancer
quotes.flavor: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

quotes.name: Walking Corpse
quotes.flavor:
"What does it mean when the dead feed on the dead? When no new life emerges, but only more death? Is it not an endless spiral into annihilation?"
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

quotes.name: Beregond of the Guard
quotes.flavor:
"Beregond, if you can, do something to stop any dreadful thing from happening."
—Pippin

quotes.name: Darksteel Ingot
quotes.flavor:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Butterbur, Bree Innkeeper
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "I hope you'll be comfortable. You'll be wanting supper, I don't doubt. As soon as may be. This way now!"

quotes.name: Nightscape Familiar
quotes.flavor: Nightscape masters prize one trait above all others: undying loyalty.

quotes.name: Silver Myr
quotes.flavor: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

quotes.name: Specter of the Fens
quotes.flavor: Foul specters hunt down those who try to back out of a deal with a daemogoth.

quotes.name: Snake Pit
quotes.flavor:
If the ground is smooth, the way will be rough.
—Deepwood saying

quotes.name: Wretched Throng
quotes.flavor:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words

quotes.name: Flutterfox
quotes.flavor:
"The white fox grinned. 'How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—*Tales of the Fae*

quotes.name: Tormod, the Desecrator
quotes.flavor: "Life is but the precursor to a long and successful death."

quotes.name: Furious Reprisal
quotes.flavor:
"Now that's the Chandra I've been waiting to see."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Swarm of Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Rats, rats, rats! Hundreds, thousands, millions of them, and every one a life."
—Bram Stoker, *Dracula*

quotes.name: Can't Stay Away
quotes.flavor: Death is no impediment to dinner.

quotes.name: Ajani's Chosen
quotes.flavor: "United, our roar will level mountains."

quotes.name: Wall of Earth
quotes.flavor: The ground shuddered violently and the earth seemed to come to life. The elemental force contained in the vast wall of earth was trapped, bent to its controller's will.

quotes.name: Pestilence Demon
quotes.flavor: "I have schemed too long to be supplanted by dead gods. If I cannot have this world, no one can."

quotes.name: Timetwister
quotes.flavor: 2012 Vintage Championship Winner

quotes.name: Farbog Revenant
quotes.flavor: Spiteful geists rise from the muck of the Farbogs, eager to lure travelers to their doom.

quotes.name: Deathless Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Over and over it rose. Over and over we fell."
—Ganda, Goma Fada deserter

quotes.name: Venerable Monk
quotes.flavor: His presence brings not only a strong arm but also renewed hope.

quotes.name: Thraben Inspector
quotes.flavor: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

quotes.name: Generous Gift
quotes.flavor: The appearance of large beasts from faraway lands remains a debate between animalfolk communities.

quotes.name: Serra Ascendant
quotes.flavor: "I laugh at gravity all the time. Hahaha, gravity."

quotes.name: Lightning Helix
quotes.flavor:
"Rage is not the answer. Rage followed by fitting vengeance is the answer."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

quotes.name: Coast Watcher
quotes.flavor: The aven came to fear the forest's clawing branches, but the watchers quickly renewed their courage.

quotes.name: Minion of Tevesh Szat
quotes.flavor:
"A minion given over to Tevesh Szat is a stronger minion gained."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Release to the Wind
quotes.flavor: "Here and gone like a fleeting breeze."

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: But *should* elves?

quotes.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
quotes.flavor:
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

quotes.name: Volcanic Geyser
quotes.flavor:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

quotes.name: Will Riker, First in the Field
quotes.flavor: "Fate protects fools, little children, and ships named *Enterprise*."

quotes.name: Reckless Ransacking
quotes.flavor: Most thieves are silent and swift, leaving no trace of their crime. Noggles take a different approach.

quotes.name: Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker
quotes.flavor: "Through me, the Great Teacher's voice will rattle this world."

quotes.name: Tome Shredder
quotes.flavor:
"Quintorius, would you care to explain why you didn't complete your homework?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

quotes.name: Razorverge Thicket
quotes.flavor: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.

quotes.name: Supply Runners
quotes.flavor: Good dogs stay by your side until the end. Great dogs leave to bring back aid.

quotes.name: Prying Eyes
quotes.flavor: "Citizen! Your crime has been recorded. Cease movement and await arrest, or further penalties will be immediately imposed."

quotes.name: Kyren Sniper
quotes.flavor: Kyren goblins always act behind the scenes—even in battle.

quotes.name: Supplant Form
quotes.flavor:
"Ice can be shaped to any form, even the whisper of a memory."
—Mytha, Temur shaman

quotes.name: Ingot Chewer
quotes.flavor: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

quotes.name: Rhystic Study
quotes.flavor:
"I'll teach you the leyline paratrigonometrics, no problem. But you need to show me how to make that fiery swirly thing."
—Zimone, to Rootha

quotes.name: Might of Alara
quotes.flavor: The combined strength of all five planes spawned creations none had seen before.

quotes.name: Mindspring Merfolk
quotes.flavor: The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths. Since then, they had fully integrated into Avishkari society.

quotes.name: Tragic Poet
quotes.flavor: "In a healing world I write—I, who will never be healed. Let my last gift be one of memory: from a thousand lost thoughts, choose one, and remember my name."

quotes.name: Xira Arien
quotes.flavor: Her wits are sharp, but her blades are sharper.

quotes.name: Seismic Strike
quotes.flavor:
"Life up here is simple. Adapt to the ways of the mountains and they will reward you. Fight them and they will end you."
—Kezim, prodigal pyromancer

quotes.name: Sulfur Falls
quotes.flavor:
"I have witnessed the creation of all life on this world and its inevitable end. There is nothing in between to challenge one such as me."
—Kang the Conqueror

quotes.name: Defend the Celestus
quotes.flavor: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

quotes.name: Fallowsage
quotes.flavor: Memories of ages past are said to swim the minds of lounging fallowsages.

quotes.name: Soldier of the Grey Host
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"The Dead awaken; for the hour is come for the oathbreakers."
—Malbeth the Seer

quotes.name: Aegis of the Gods
quotes.flavor: Athreos cares little for the other gods' conflict with mortals. He is concerned only with safe passage for the dead.

quotes.name: Confound
quotes.flavor: "Did I know Szat would betray us?" Urza asked quizzically. "I was counting on it."

quotes.name: Koth of the Homestead
quotes.flavor: "Malach, tell your mother the steelfruit harvest is abundant this cycle!"

quotes.name: Jazal Goldmane
quotes.flavor:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Lord of the Undead
quotes.flavor:
"I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"
—Lord Dralnu

quotes.name: Scorching Dragonfire
quotes.flavor: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

quotes.name: Glory Seeker
quotes.flavor: The turning of the tide always begins with one soldier's decision to head back into the fray.

quotes.name: Brilliant Plan
quotes.flavor: A heaven-sent vision is like a lantern to guide the way.

quotes.name: Wakandan Drone Flock
quotes.flavor: Wakandan engineers look to nature for inspiration as they develop new technologies.

quotes.name: Argothian Sprite
quotes.flavor:
"Make the exhaust vents smaller next time!"
—Urza, notes to his engineers

quotes.name: Eiganjo Uprising
quotes.flavor: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.

quotes.name: Blowfly Infestation
quotes.flavor: When the giant Tollek Worldslayer fell, a corruption erupted from his corpse to carry on his name.

quotes.name: The Queen of Dale
quotes.flavor: Dale may grow to reclaim its former glory and splendor, as in the days before the Dragon came.

quotes.name: Grixis Battlemage
quotes.flavor: Vitals of Grixis who eschew undeath must scrape and scratch to retain their mortality. The result is a breed of inventive mages.

quotes.name: Spinny Ride
quotes.flavor: There's no such thing as upside down in space. Put another way, there are infinite upside downs in space.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor: "Architectural Reconfiguration System. It reconstructs particles according to your needs," explained the Doctor. "A machine that makes machines?" Gregor questioned.

quotes.name: Cardboard Carapace
quotes.flavor: . . . that exciting . . . about . . .

quotes.name: Ancient Craving
quotes.flavor: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

quotes.name: D'Avenant Archer
quotes.flavor: Avenant's archers are also trained as poets, so that each arrow is guided by a fragment of verse.

quotes.name: Rowan, Scion of War
quotes.flavor: "No more days withering at a negotiating table with my brother. I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power."

quotes.name: Subjugator Angel
quotes.flavor: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

quotes.name: Claws of Valakut
quotes.flavor: "Swords may sunder. Shields may fail. My will is stronger than steel, and my flesh and bone far more deadly."

quotes.name: Thrill-Kill Assassin
quotes.flavor: As the bounty on Massacre Girl rose, so did the number of imitators.

quotes.name: Ekundu Cyclops
quotes.flavor:
"Big one I, One big eye. One-eye see Two-eye die!"
—Traditional cyclops chant

quotes.name: Inspiring Vantage
quotes.flavor: First Miku takes the stage, then she takes your breath away.

quotes.name: Stormcarved Coast
quotes.flavor: Frequent, violent storms shape the Nephalia coastline, sculpting cliffs and caves where monsters often lurk.

quotes.name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
quotes.flavor:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek

quotes.name: Wickerbough Elder
quotes.flavor: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

quotes.name: Darkness
quotes.flavor:
"If I must die, I will encounter darkness as a bride, / And hug it in mine arms."
—William Shakespeare,
*Measure for Measure*

quotes.name: Crystal Barricade
quotes.flavor:
"Good as new!"
—Krek, daysquad captain

quotes.name: Beetleback Chief
quotes.flavor: Great goblin warlords lead vast hordes into battle from atop mighty siege-beasts. Lesser chiefs get a couple of squires and a big bug.

quotes.name: Abrupt Decay
quotes.flavor: Local Purveyor Honest Rutstein Clarifies, Strengthens "No Refunds" Policy

quotes.name: Rootbound Crag
quotes.flavor:
"Did Sephiroth... do this?"
—Cloud Strife

quotes.name: Myr Sire
quotes.flavor: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

quotes.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
quotes.flavor: The earth walks, strongest of all.

quotes.name: Boompile
quotes.flavor:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now . . . which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

quotes.name: Starfall
quotes.flavor:
"The most brilliant stars are not born of Nyx."
—Rhexenor, Akroan flamespeaker

quotes.name: Grisly Salvage
quotes.flavor: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

quotes.name: Go-Shintai of Boundless Vigor
quotes.flavor: It seeks those with untamed spirits and offers wild strength.

quotes.name: Rise from the Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Lithoform Blight
quotes.flavor: Heedless of Nissa's warnings, Nahiri repeated history.

quotes.name: Vial of Dragonfire
quotes.flavor:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words

quotes.name: Winds of Change
quotes.flavor: Sometimes, a butterfly flapping its wings is insufficient.

quotes.name: Devoted Druid
quotes.flavor: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

quotes.name: Setessan Champion
quotes.flavor: "A blessing is not a gift. It is a duty."

quotes.name: Kelpie Guide
quotes.flavor: Kelpies are drawn to paradoxes, making them ideal companions for Quandrix mages.

quotes.name: True Believer
quotes.flavor: So great is his certainty that mere facts cannot shake it.

quotes.name: Platinum Angel
quotes.flavor:
"Serra built angels from the spirits of fallen warriors, but I believe a more mundane power source might suffice."
—Karn

quotes.name: Finale of Revelation
quotes.flavor: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

quotes.name: Wild Mongrel
quotes.flavor: It teaches *you* to play dead.

quotes.name: Timber Wolves
quotes.flavor: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

quotes.name: Shoe Tree
quotes.flavor: It grows several feet a year.

quotes.name: Coral Eel
quotes.flavor: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

quotes.name: Twilight Mire
quotes.flavor: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

quotes.name: Benalish Marshal
quotes.flavor:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—*History of Benalia*

quotes.name: Tidal Wave
quotes.flavor:
"The floor of the sea is paved with the shattered remnants of vessels that navigated its surface unwelcomed."
—Thassa, god of the sea

quotes.name: Atraxa's Fall
quotes.flavor:
"Fallen angels should stay fallen."
—Henzie "Toolbox" Torre

quotes.name: Nexos
quotes.flavor: The blessed union of gun, claw, and merciless intent is a force to be truly feared.

quotes.name: Sami, Wildcat Captain
quotes.flavor: "The hard way it is."

quotes.name: Selenia, Dark Angel
quotes.flavor:
"I am light. I am dark. I must give my life to serve; not even death can release me."
—Selenia, dark angel

quotes.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
quotes.flavor: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Peri Brown
quotes.flavor: "I'm Perpugilliam Brown and I can shout just as loud as you can!"

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

quotes.name: Dwarven Sea Clan
quotes.flavor:
"No dwarf alive can best one of my crew dead."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

quotes.name: Hint of Insanity
quotes.flavor: "Practice makes perfect, but obsession makes better."

quotes.name: Heliod's Intervention
quotes.flavor: "I bring a dawn that no night can follow."

quotes.name: Second Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"The cornfields promise a good yield this season."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

quotes.name: Dash Hopes
quotes.flavor:
"Focus an enemy's mind on what's already gone, and it's easier to take away more."
—Holux, stronghold racketeer

quotes.name: Serpent Warrior
quotes.flavor: A hiss before dying.

quotes.name: Anrakyr the Traveller
quotes.flavor: "Though it may take an eternity, I will see the myriad dynasties united once more."

quotes.name: Canker Abomination
quotes.flavor: Once the hideous disease takes hold, it spreads through both bark and mind.

quotes.name: Heartfire Immolator
quotes.flavor: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."

quotes.name: Spin Engine
quotes.flavor:
"It will be battle-ready before our strike at Oxid Ridge, and it will guarantee our victory."
—Ketuc of the Helm

quotes.name: Feast or Famine
quotes.flavor:
"The living cannot understand the benefits of death."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

quotes.name: Kargan Dragonrider
quotes.flavor: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

quotes.name: Altar's Reap
quotes.flavor:
"I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time."
—Ob Nixilis

quotes.name: Fog
quotes.flavor:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

quotes.name: Orcish Captain
quotes.flavor: There's a chance to win every battle.

quotes.name: Obsianus Golem
quotes.flavor:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone . . ."
—Song of the Artificer

quotes.name: Exorcist
quotes.flavor: Though they often bore little greater charm than the demons they battled, exorcists were always welcome in Scarwood.

quotes.name: Jalira, Master Polymorphist
quotes.flavor: "You can become anything if I just put my mind to it."

quotes.name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
quotes.flavor:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

quotes.name: Assault Strobe
quotes.flavor: When breaking someone's face once just isn't enough.

quotes.name: Aesthir Glider
quotes.flavor: An ancient device recovered from a thawing glacier high in the Karplusan mountains.

quotes.name: Plague Beetle
quotes.flavor: No one knows whether they were named for the diseases they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

quotes.name: Venom
quotes.flavor:
"I told him it was just a flesh wound, but the next time I looked at him, poor Tadhg was dead and gone."
—Maeveen O'Donagh,
*Memoirs of a Soldier*

quotes.name: Gleaming Splendor
quotes.flavor: Bilbo had heard tell and sing of Dragon-hoards before, but the splendor, the lust, the glory of such treasure had never yet come home to him.

quotes.name: Illusory Wrappings
quotes.flavor:
"No amount of strength can help you overcome my trial. You must be ready to forgo your body and favor your mind."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

quotes.name: Spark Rupture
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: Phyrexia was defeated, but the repercussions of the invasion rippled through the Blind Eternities.

quotes.name: Singularity Rupture
quotes.flavor:
"Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin

quotes.name: Oakshade Stalker // Moonlit Ambusher
quotes.flavor: Even when he strikes, the only sound is the snap of jaws through bone.

quotes.name: Tangle
quotes.flavor: Gaea battles rampant death with abundant life.

quotes.name: Disappearing Act
quotes.flavor:
"Baral took my family from me back then. I'd do anything to face him now."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

quotes.name: Sunlit Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"Ah, our guests have arrived!"
-—Aenc Thon, Lord of the Lingering Gaze

quotes.name: Harmonic Prodigy
quotes.flavor: "Why would I deprive the crowd of an encore?"

quotes.name: Blue Sun's Twilight
quotes.flavor:
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Seismic Assault
quotes.flavor:
"In a war for survival, Dominaria itself became a weapon. The malice is gone, but the danger remains."
—Jhoira

quotes.name: Traumatize
quotes.flavor:
"La mente educada está llena de conocimiento y sabiduría. Por eso es la más propensa a caer bajo su propio peso."
—Embajador Laquatus

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor: Knowing the Hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.

quotes.name: Uphill Battle
quotes.flavor: Cho-Manno knew he had no choice but to ally with Gerrard. If that's what it took to free his people, he'd pay the price.

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok . . . .

quotes.name: Song-Mad Treachery // Song-Mad Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"I'm not proud of the things I did. But all I could think about at the time was how to make the noise stop."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim
quotes.flavor: "All will bow to the Whispering One."

quotes.name: Slimebind
quotes.flavor:
"Relax. It's quite harmless. And it will dissolve completely in a month or two."
—Navona, Simic field tester

quotes.name: Collar the Culprit
quotes.flavor:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

quotes.name: Talisman of Progress
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes my brilliance astonishes even me!"
—The Fourth Doctor

quotes.name: Treasure Trove
quotes.flavor: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents over sleeping children.

quotes.name: Second Harvest
quotes.flavor: "Each year at summer's end, I gather water lilies, green leaves and lilies white to please my pretty lady, the last ere the year's end to keep them from the winter, to flower by her pretty feet till the snows are melted."

quotes.name: Rock Badger
quotes.flavor:
"As it charged our keep, I mistook it for a bear. After it tore through our ramparts and half the guard, I wished it had been a bear after all."
—Ballista guard

quotes.name: Angelic Wall
quotes.flavor:
"The Ancestor protects us in ways we can't begin to comprehend."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Geth, Thane of Contracts
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: "It seems someone forgot to read the fine print."

quotes.name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
quotes.flavor: Not suitable for children . . . who aren't ready to have a lot of fun!

quotes.name: Parish-Blade Trainee
quotes.flavor: The recruits trained in eternal night, fueled by the hope that they might one day see the sun again.

quotes.name: Defiant Bloodlord
quotes.flavor:
"Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

quotes.name: Chronostutter
quotes.flavor: Timing is everything.

quotes.name: Blade of the Sixth Pride
quotes.flavor: "My pride may be gone, but our hunt is not over."

quotes.name: Gravepurge
quotes.flavor:
"Lord Silumgar has given you a second chance to please him."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

quotes.name: Curate
quotes.flavor: "Aha! This must be one of the ancient keys to... No, wait. It's just another puzzle toy."

quotes.name: Fountain of Youth
quotes.flavor: The Fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.

quotes.name: Dalek Drone
quotes.flavor: "Elevate."

quotes.name: Hunted Wumpus
quotes.flavor: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

quotes.name: Spore Frog
quotes.flavor: A progenitor of tadpoles and allergies in equal measure.

quotes.name: Kindred Discovery
quotes.flavor: It is in the nature of a hero to inspire others.

quotes.name: Spiteful Blow
quotes.flavor:
"Only a fool takes Phenax at his word. What do you expect from a god born of lies and betrayal?"
—Verenes, priest of Iroas

quotes.name: Unquestioned Authority
quotes.flavor: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

quotes.name: Brambleguard Veteran
quotes.flavor: "Why should the birdfolk get the best view?"

quotes.name: Rise from the Tides
quotes.flavor:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Spiketail Hatchling
quotes.flavor: It dodges waves of water to prepare for waves of magic.

quotes.name: Bellowing Mauler
quotes.flavor: He's pretty sure he can't get charged with murder if he calls it "organic demolition."

quotes.name: Treasure Nabber
quotes.flavor: The Law of Givesies Backsies is respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

quotes.name: Grim Poppet
quotes.flavor: Beware a scarecrow bearing gifts—especially sloshing vessels of acid.

quotes.name: Jace's Archivist
quotes.flavor: "This is a sacred duty. Master Beleren's trust has bought an eternity of my loyalty."

quotes.name: Stormcarved Coast
quotes.flavor:
"Solar tsunami. Came directly from your sun. A tidal wave of radiation. Big, big, big."
—The Eleventh Doctor

quotes.name: Psychosis Crawler
quotes.flavor:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

quotes.name: Jailbreak
quotes.flavor: Obscura spies rarely stay locked up long enough to make it to trial.

quotes.name: Maro
quotes.flavor: No two see the same Maro.

quotes.name: Nimana Skitter-Sneak
quotes.flavor: "When navigating dangerous terrain, one hundred legs are better than two."

quotes.name: Saltblast
quotes.flavor: Dominaria erodes with each passing gust.

quotes.name: Consign to the Pit
quotes.flavor: First your whole life flashes before your eyes. Then you have considerable time to reflect on every regret as you plummet.

quotes.name: Tranquilize
quotes.flavor: A dead guard is evidence, a sleeping one a distraction.

quotes.name: Dregs of Sorrow
quotes.flavor: Crovax gazed upon the dead, and for one dark moment he saw a banquet.

quotes.name: Giant Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Only the most effective tactics stand the test of time."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

quotes.name: Kavaron Skywarden
quotes.flavor: Scavengers looking to steal from Kav mining sites rarely make that mistake again.

quotes.name: Soulcatcher
quotes.flavor: "Their spirits walk the winds and fill my soul."

quotes.name: It Doesn't Add Up
quotes.flavor:
"Etrata claims she has no memory of committing the murder. Somehow, I believe she's telling the truth."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

quotes.name: Furycalm Snarl
quotes.flavor:
"Too long I have stayed my hand. No more."
—The War Doctor

quotes.name: Quarrel's End
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"It is a joy to us to see you return into your own."
—Éomer

quotes.name: Annihilate
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

quotes.name: Thopter Foundry
quotes.flavor:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Charging Tuskodon
quotes.flavor: It doesn't hold grudges. It runs them down and impales them.

quotes.name: Preposterous Proportions
quotes.flavor:
"I think you mean giant lemures, a type of malevolent spirit that . . . OH GODS, WHAT IS THAT?!"
—Uriah the Smug, last words

quotes.name: Kavu Climber
quotes.flavor:
The kavu might be above you
—Llanowar expression meaning "keep an open mind"

quotes.name: Spellbreaker Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Some think its immunity to countermagic evolved because of the constant mage attacks on Naya. I think it just ate a bunch of wizards."
—Broka, drumhunter

quotes.name: Reenact the Crime
quotes.flavor: At Proft's command, an ethereal model of the ransacked workshop sprang into being, every detail perfectly recreated. He'd missed something—he knew it—but what?

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

quotes.name: Jaws of Defeat
quotes.flavor:
"The Jeskai like talking about their Way? Let's see them talk their way out of this dilemma."
—Girdah, Abzan beastrider

quotes.name: Path to Exile
quotes.flavor:
"Go now, Wormtongue, whither you will. But then, if we ever meet again, I shall not be merciful."
—Théoden

quotes.name: Cauldron Familiar
quotes.flavor: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

quotes.name: Rowen
quotes.flavor: Those who understand the forest are free to harvest its bounty.

quotes.name: Patchwork Gnomes
quotes.flavor: When building gnomes, dwarves adhere to the highest standards. The gnomes themselves aren't as particular.

quotes.name: Titans' Vanguard
quotes.flavor: With a shriek, it directed the spawn toward the temple where the refugees sheltered.

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

quotes.name: Plasm Capture
quotes.flavor:
"Everything serves a purpose. Even you."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

quotes.name: Drudge Skeletons
quotes.flavor:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral,
*Necromancer's Handbook*

quotes.name: Reclusive Artificer
quotes.flavor: It's not wise to disturb an artist at work.

quotes.name: Arguel's Blood Fast // Temple of Aclazotz
quotes.flavor: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

quotes.name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: "I order you to volunteer."

quotes.name: Refurbish
quotes.flavor:
"There's no reason to buy a new one when I've got the tools to fix the one you've got."
—Ripu, repair specialist

quotes.name: Boreal Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"More than snow falls from the Boreal skies."
—Arkin Egilsson, skycaptain

quotes.name: Hordeling Outburst
quotes.flavor:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"We don't make mistakes, just happy little accidents."
—Bob Ross

quotes.name: Deepfire Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"There are deep, deep places in this world that have long burned hot with little regard for the whitening of the earth's thin skin."
—Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper

quotes.name: Biowaste Blob
quotes.flavor:
"The Simic will be fined for contaminating the waterways. In the meantime, seize that blob!"
—Arrester Polgar

quotes.name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
quotes.flavor:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

quotes.name: Arashin Sovereign
quotes.flavor: Dromoka dragons foster trust among their subjects, while the other clans must spend their time quelling rebellion.

quotes.name: Spawn of Rix Maadi
quotes.flavor:
"Straight from the blood-drenched imagination of our illustrious parun!"
—Nyoser, Gore-House ringleader

quotes.name: Dread Return
quotes.flavor: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

quotes.name: Moonlit Lamenter
quotes.flavor: Isilu's adherents mourn the dead, purging grief through keening rituals.
